newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Brookdale, DTM flat.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Brookdale, DTM flat.

text.p: The following two companies made their market debuts on Friday on the Nasdaq:
-- Brookdale Living Communities Inc, which offers assisted living services to the elderly, closed unchanged at 11-1/2.

The company raised $48.1 million -- only about half of what it originally estimated -- after an underwriting discount in the IPO of 4.5 million shares. The Chicago-based company originally filed to offer about 6.25 million shares to price at about $16, which would have raised nearly $100 million.
-- Shares of DTM Corp closed unchanged at $8 each, after the company was forced to offer the 3.039 million shares for a bargain price.
It had initally expected to price shares at between $9 and $11 each. The company deals in rapid prototyping and rapid tooling systems.
